_note: Hand-curated gold CL terms for hECA/uHAF heart labels, assigned from the 50-gene deep marker sets (heca_markers_deep_Heart.json) and NOT from the label string. Where markers contradict the label, the markers decide. 'null' = markers too non-specific, or a cell STATE rather than a type (abstention); these must not be scored as misses.
_disagrees_with_label: Neuroglial cell (MPZ-adjacent PLP1/PMP22/SCN7A/GPM6B/LGI4 = Schwann cell); Myeloid cell (LYVE1/VSIG4/STAB1 = resident macrophage); Naive CD4 T cell (LEF1 present but no CD4-restricted evidence, so the general naive T term is used); Proliferating macrophage (MKI67/TOP2A/CENPF only - a cell state with no lineage evidence, abstained); MAIT cell (no SLC4A10 or TRAV1-2, so scored as T cell)
